above.name: Matthaeus Kosinar
above.when: witness at Franz's marriage in 1800, signing with a cross
above.what: Father or brother of Franz — and nothing says which. The oldest of the name reached.
above.cite: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1780-1815 - one of the two Beystaende at the marriage of Franz Kosinar and Maria Dortshen, entered "MATTHAEUS KOSINAR" and SIGNING WITH A CROSS, so he could not write. The other witness is "Simon Rauth"; both are entered "Bauern". A man of the same surname standing witness for a 24-year-old groom is most likely his father or his brother, and NOTHING HERE SAYS WHICH. He is the oldest Kosinar this archive has reached. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33

above.name: Franz Kosinar
above.when: b. about 1775–76 · m. 27 October 1800 · d. 22 January 1849, aged 73
above.what: Martin's grandfather. A Häusler at Feichting house 10, and an Ausnehmer — retired — by the end. He died at Oberfeichting 9, in his son's house: THE HOUSE HIS GRANDSON MARTIN WAS BORN IN eight years earlier.
above.cite: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1780-1815, read 22 September 2026 - "Den 27ten [8ber 1800] · Feichting b. St. Joh. · 10. · FRANZ KOSINAR · katholisch · 24 · ledig" marrying "MARIA DORTSHEN · katholisch · 20 · ledig". Witnesses "MATTHAEUS KOSINAR" and "Simon Rauth", Bauern, Matthaeus signing with a cross; married by "Matthaeus Lauts, coop.", Pfarrer St. Martin. SO HE WAS BORN ABOUT 1776 and she about 1780. Named again as "Franz Kosinar, Hueblar" at his daughter GERTRAUD's baptism, 18 March 1814 at HOUSE 10 (sig. 00885 image 15), and as "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" in the Aeltern des Braeutigams column at his son JOHANN's marriage of 6 January 1833 (sig. 00899 image 37). He is Martin Kozina's grandfather, four generations above Hedviga. His own baptism would be about 1776 and so in sig. 00883 (1747-1779), NOT looked for yet. HIS DEATH, read 22 September 2026: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.61 - "22. - 24. [Jaenner 1849] · Ob. Feichtg · 9 · FRANZ KOSINA, Ausnehmer · katholisch · maennlich · ALTER 73 · Lungenentzuendung · versehen". DIED 22 JANUARY 1849, BURIED 24 JANUARY, AGED 73 - which puts his birth at 1775-76 and CONFIRMS the age of 24 he gave at his marriage, from a second and independent record. He is an AUSNEHMER, a retired householder living on the Ausnahm, and he died at OBERFEICHTING No. 9 - not at house 10, the family house, but at his son Johann's. He had handed over and retired into it, AND IT IS THE HOUSE HIS GRANDSON MARTIN WAS BORN IN eight years earlier. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33 and sig. 00895 image 62

above.name: Maria "Mina" Domshan
above.what: Martin's grandmother. Written «Dortshen» in 1800, «Do[m]shan» in 1814 and «Tom[sh]shan» in 1833 — three clerks, and not smoothed into one.
above.cite: Poročna knjiga 1780-1815 - "MARIA DORTSHEN, katholisch, 20, ledig", marrying Franz Kosinar on 27 October 1800, SO BORN ABOUT 1780. THE SURNAME IS STILL NOT SECURE and now has three renderings from three clerks: "Dortshen" in 1800, "Maria Do[m]shan" written over two lines at her daughter's baptism in 1814, and "Mina Tom[sh]shan" at her son's marriage in 1833. MINA is the short form these registers use for Marija. Recorded as read, at full magnification, and NOT smoothed into one spelling. HER DEATH IS NOT FOUND. The K section of the death index for 1836-1869 (sig. 04635, images 182-183) carries exactly TWO Kozina - Franz in 1849 and Luzia in 1850 - AND SHE IS NOT ONE OF THEM. So she died before 1836, or after 1869, or somewhere else. The index for 1812-1835 (sig. 04634) has a K section around images 126-128 and HAS NOT BEEN READ. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33, sig. 00885 image 15, sig. 00899 image 37

above.name: Johann Kosina
above.when: b. about 1802–03 · m. 6 January 1833 · Oberfeichting house 9
above.what: Martin's uncle, and the householder of the house Martin was born in.
above.cite: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1816-1855, book p.35 - "1833, 6. Jaenner, Obern feichting 9, JOHANN KOSINAR, Haeusler, katholisch, 30 Jahre, ledig" marrying "LUZIA LABORNIK, 38, ledig". HIS PARENTS: "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" and "Mina Tom[sh]shan, Haeuslerin". Born about 1802-03. THE BRIDE IS THE PROOF: Johann Kosina, Haeusler of Oberfeichting 9, had his first child with Lucia Labornik on 20 January 1834, a year and a fortnight later - so the house, the trade, the wife and the date all agree and the identification does not rest on the surname at all. Children ANTON 1834 and PETRUS 1836 at Oberfeichting 9; later children FRANZ 1853 and ANA 1856 with a second wife URSULA SEDEJ. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00899 image 37, sig. 00886 images 19 and 34

above.name: Lucia Labornik
above.when: b. about 1795 · m. 6 January 1833, aged 38 · d. 30 November 1850, aged 55
above.what: Johann's wife — Martin's aunt by marriage rather than his blood, and the woman keeping the house he was born in. She died there of the same pneumonia as her father-in-law, twenty-two months after him, and that is why Johann is beside a second wife by 1853.
above.cite: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869, book p.71 - "30. - 2. Xbr [1850] · Ob. Feichtg · 9 · LUZIA KOSINA, Hueblersweib · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 55 · Lungenentzuendung · versehen · Jos. Kartely". DIED 30 NOVEMBER 1850, BURIED 2 DECEMBER, AGED 55, so born about 1795 - and she was 38 at her marriage in January 1833, which gives 1794-95. THE SAME WOMAN. She is entered a Hueblers-WEIB and not a widow, which is right: Johann outlived her. AND IT EXPLAINS THE SECOND WIFE - Johann is beside Ursula Sedej by 1853 because Lucia died in 1850. Married 6 January 1833 aged 38 to Johann Kosina, Haeusler of Oberfeichting 9 (Porocna knjiga 1816-1855 p.35); her parents "Ma[thes] Labornik, Haeusler" and "Gertraud Mag[nishan]"; mother of Anton 1834 and Petrus 1836. SAME HOUSE AND SAME DISEASE AS FRANZ, twenty-two months apart. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00899 image 37 and sig. 00895 image 72

above.name: Gertraud "Gertruda" Kosina
above.what: MARTIN'S MOTHER — the «Gertruda» the tree knows only as a name. Twenty-seven when she bore him, and unmarried.
above.cite: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831, book p.28 - "den 18. Merz, Haus 10, Gertrud, ehelich, Vater: FRANZ KOSINAR, Hueblar, Mutter: MARIA DO[M]SHAN". She was 27 when she bore Martin. HER BROTHER IS JOHANN: his marriage of 6 January 1833 gives his father as "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" and his mother as "Mina Tom[sh]shan, Haeuslerin" - the same couple. RETRACTION: on 21 September 2026 this entry was ELIMINATED here on the grounds that the surname "ends in a clear -r, so it is KOSNAR not Kosina". That was wrong. The -r is how THIS clerk writes the family name, and he writes it identically for Johann, whose own children are entered KOSINA by the next clerk. One family, two hands. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 15 and sig. 00899 image 37
